        - api: write
        - api: fputwc
        - api: putwc
        - api: fputws
        - api: fwrite
        - api: putwchar
        - api: dprintf
        - api: vdprintf
        - api: fprintf
        - api: vfprintf

signature_matches.name: terminate process via kill
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: terminate process via kill
    namespace: host-interaction/process/terminate
    authors:
      - joakim@intezer.com
    scopes:
      static: basic block
      dynamic: call
    mbc:
      - Process::Terminate Process [C0018]
    examples:
      - 7351f8a40c5450557b24622417fc478d:0x402424
  features:
    - and:
      - os: linux
      - api: kill
      - or:
        - number: 1 = SIGHUP - controlling terminal closed
        - number: 2 = SIGINT - interupt process stream, ctrl-C
        - number: 3 = SIGQUIT - like ctrl-C but with a core dump
        - number: 6 = SIGABRT
        - number: 9 = SIGKILL - terminate immediately/hard kill
        - number: 15 = SIGTERM - terminate whenever/soft kill
        - number: 19 = SIGSTOP - Pause the process / free command line, ctrl-Z

signature_matches.name: create process on Linux
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: create process on Linux
    namespace: host-interaction/process/create
    authors:
      - joakim@intezer.com
      - mehunhoff@google.com
    scopes:
      static: basic block
      dynamic: call
    mbc:
      - Process::Create Process [C0017]
    examples:
      - 7351f8a40c5450557b24622417fc478d:0x40236D
  features:
    - and:
      - or:
        - os: linux
        - os: android
      - or:
        - api: execve
        - and:
          - match: execute syscall
          - arch: aarch64
          - number: 0xdd = execve
        - api: execl
        - api: execlp
        - api: execle
        - api: execv
        - api: execvp
        - api: execvpe
        - api: posix_spawn
        - api: posix_spawnp
        - api: popen
        - api: fork

signature_matches.name: write and execute a file
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: write and execute a file
    namespace: communication/c2/file-transfer
    maec/malware-category: launcher
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: span of calls
    mbc:
      - Execution::Install Additional Program [B0023]
    examples:
      - 9324D1A8AE37A36AE560C37448C9705A:0x403A40
      - Practical Malware Analysis Lab 01-04.exe_:0x4011FC
  features:
    - and:
      - match: host-interaction/file-system/write
      - match: host-interaction/process/create
